snippet.title: the thing dev 1
snippet.description:
Hey guys, a fan project in development bringing The Thing story into new heights by leveraging the amazing Max-Fx Engine used in the legendary game Max Payne. 

After iterating a lot, the project started originally in Unreal Engine 3, while I wanted to unlock somehow Rainbow Six Vegas 1 Unreal Editor, to build the new game around the 360 cover system. 
Unfortunately that wasn't possible with the limited knowledge I had on UE3 games.
The break-though started by learning the open source DHEWM3 project, which aimed to bring Doom3 idtech3 engine to developers to play with. 

That system was more closer to the original idea I had in mind, what makes a good horror video game, and the atmosphere I wanted to bring over to The Thing remake. Getting into modding, learning different engines was a long process with many research involved.

Max Payne was also always close to my heart, and for me personally the best Action-TPS ever made. The TPS camera system, the noir feeling all added a very great way how to tell stories captivating audiences world-wide.
Once I found out, that the creators of Max Payne also released a lot of modding tools to change the Max Payne source code, it was just a matter of time until I found 20 years of accumulated knowledge of tutorials, mods,and necessary files to build great games with Max-FX(the engine running Max Payne).

Max-FX had a lot of ready to use tools, such as MaxED(the editor), ParticleFX(particle editor), and different plugins for 3d art creations such as 3dsMax, Maya and Milkshape plugins allowing devs to easily manipulate the assets of the game.

This was handy, and easy to collect thanks to the generous community members shared these awesome programs online on www.moddb.com and different MaxPayne forums/fan websites.

Currently I started to modify the Max-FX files in data/datasource, such as HUD, graphic novels etc, menu, etc.

Discord:
https://discord.gg/YgzHqRSD54

If you are interested bringing this story to life, feel free to reach out on discord, as I want to build a team.
